address: Rua de São Pedro de Alcântara 59, Lisbon, 1200-459, Portugal
bio: If the idea of a culinary journey appeals to you, book a table at this restaurant where chef Kiko Martins offers guests a completely new culinary concept in Lisbon. His cuisine, available on an à la carte and an impressive tasting menu based around dishes from the former, showcases a fusion of flavours on a voyage of gastronomic discovery to Mexico and Japan, ably supported by Portuguese ingredients....
